title: Edgedancer
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A short Stormlight Archive novella following Lift, a cheerful young thief who is also a powerful wind-riding Edgedancer. She is in a city where she is trying to keep her head down, until a threat pulls her into a task she can't ignore.
readIf: you want a quick, funny and big-hearted taste of the Stormlight world focused on one character.
skipIf: you haven't read at least the first two Stormlight books, as it depends on their world and events.

pairings.reason: Another light, warm and funny Sanderson story with a plucky heroine and a charming fairy-tale voice.
A short, whimsical fantasy with a headstrong heroine and a witty, wandering tone.
The first Stormlight book, for fans who want to meet this world in its full scope.
